testcase.name: Scenario: Show a part shortcut in part documents but not an assembly: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/current-quick-access-source/features/application/quick-access-toolbar/quick-access-toolbar.feature:127:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Show a part shortcut in part documents but not an assembly ✔ Given "fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartOne.opd", "fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartTwo.opd" and "fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/Assembly.oad" are open in the MCAD Software ✔ And PartOne.opd is active ✔ And Extrude has been added to the quick access toolbar from its ribbon ✔ When the user activates Assembly.oad ✔ Then the Extrude shortcut is not shown on its quick access toolbar ✔ When the user reactivates PartOne.opd ✔ Then the Extrude shortcut is visible again ✔ When the user activates PartTwo.opd ✔ Then the Extrude shortcut is visible there as well ✔ And PartTwo.opd remains active
